messages.text: BL-1772 🎵 in progress — The --push publish path and QA's standing hand-build recipe never re-point swarmforge-QA, so the land walk's cost bound (BL-1438 / BL-1461) is not in effect on the path QA actually uses and every land walks about 2700 branch-only commits for about 20 minutes (2026-09-26): after LAND_PUBLISHED, --push invokes the same post-land-repoint! --land already runs, and the QA land recipe publishes through that path
